hero.label: Made for Sendoso
hero.headline: I want to build pipeline for the company redefining how B2B buyers get noticed.
hero.subheadline: Sendoso sits at a genuinely rare intersection: gifting, intent data, and omni-channel outbound, all wrapped into one platform that makes prospects feel something before a sales call even happens. I spent over a year doing cold outreach at an AI startup and know firsthand how hard it is to break through the noise. Sendoso is the tool I wish I had, and I want to be on the team that sells it.

whyCompany.title: Gifting as a channel is still massively underutilized in B2B outbound
whyCompany.body: Most BDR teams are fighting over the same cold email and LinkedIn playbook, which means response rates keep shrinking. Sendoso gives reps a genuinely differentiated wedge to open conversations that competitors cannot easily copy. That is a real structural advantage, and it makes the BDR job more interesting and more effective at the same time.

whyCompany.title: Sendoso is hiring BDRs while doubling down on outbound as a growth lever
whyCompany.body: The fact that this BDR role sits inside the Marketing org and feeds directly into Account Executives tells me Sendoso is serious about building a repeatable outbound motion, not just filling a seat. That is the kind of structured, high-ownership environment where I learn the most and contribute the fastest. Getting in at this stage means I help shape the playbook, not just run it.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and digital marketing experience maps directly to what this role needs
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I personally ran cold outreach sequences in HubSpot and LinkedIn, helped the company land 15 to 20 paying clients, and learned what it takes to get VP and C-level buyers to respond. At NextAfter I shifted into digital marketing strategy for B2B fundraising clients, which sharpened how I think about messaging, audience targeting, and campaign structure. Both experiences feed directly into Sendoso's omni-channel outbound model.

quote: I have sat in the BDR seat and felt the exact problem Sendoso solves. I want to join the team that gets to hand prospects the solution.
